name: Catania
tagline: Baroque Sicily in the shadow of Mount Etna
summary: Catania is eastern Sicily's lively hub, rebuilt in black lava stone baroque beneath Europe's most active volcano. Climb or ride up Mount Etna, browse the roaring fish market, eat arancini and pasta alla Norma, and day-trip to clifftop Taormina.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are warm; summer is very hot and Etna can be cold and windy at the top any time.
arrival: Catania Airport is 15 to 20 minutes from the centre by Alibus.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; buses go to Etna and Taormina, or rent a car.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; carry a few euros for coffee bars, tips and small shops.
foodTip: Arancini, pasta alla Norma, horse-meat grills and granita with brioche.
buyTip: Pistachio from Bronte, ceramics and lava-stone crafts.
